title: pullback_of_ctf_eq
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell, and any field k. For every morphism v between standing schemes of [def-sfb-integral-compact-support-interface], the actual total derived inverse image with integral coefficient O_E preserves Dbc and Loc(Dbc). Identify these with Dctf and Loc(Dctf) by [det-def-localizing-closure-ctf-equals-bc], then use [det-proper-base-change-unbounded-pullback].

source.place: Final paragraph, comparison, composition and base-change normalization.

proof.text: For each standing scheme, its quasi-compact structure morphism to Spec k gives compactness, and its separated structure morphism gives quasi-separatedness. In Sheaf.Paper.UnboundedLocalizingPullback, the proved private helpers pullback_constructible and pullback_bounded_constructible apply to arbitrary condensed commutative coefficients on qcqs schemes, without the characteristic assumptions of the public unboundedLocalizingPullback theorem. Use a proof-only import all to apply them at O_E and v.hom.left, obtaining preservation of generators directly.

Apply the same module's proved private helper pullback_of_constructible to obtain UnboundedLocalizingPullback at O_E. For source and target specialize localizingClosure_ctf_equals_bc using the identity monoid-object isomorphism at the finite intermediate field E. Its localizing-closure equality identifies localizingClosureProEtale with IntegralCompactSupport.localizing. Transport source membership to the former closure, apply the localizing field to the associated full-subcategory object, and transport target membership back. No positive-characteristic, distinct-prime or nonemptiness assumption is used.

proof_origin.place: V3 Lean proof, 2026-10-26: reuse the general qcqs pullback helpers and transport localizing-closure membership using the integral ctf=bc equality.

theorem pullback_of_ctf_eq (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    {X Y : Spaces k} (v : X ⟶ Y) :
    (∀ K, generators (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) Y.obj.left K →
      generators (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) X.obj.left ((pull
        (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) v.hom.left).obj K)) ∧
    (∀ K, localizing (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) Y.obj.left K →
      localizing (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) X.obj.left ((pull
        (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) v.hom.left).obj K))
